title: Sync completed GitHub issues when closing a milestone plan

nodes.title: Tracer bullet: Close completed issues and verify the GitHub milestone on the plan-close path
nodes.why: Pre-M3 finished with eight completed issues still open on GitHub.
nodes.cuts: Record the GitHub repository and milestone number for milestone-backed plans at creation. On the existing main plan-close commit path, read the committed plan before deletion and use its explicit Closes #N references. Preflight node completion, issue membership and any unrelated open issues before mutation. Support existing milestone plans with Closes references by resolving unambiguous metadata; fail visibly on ambiguity. Close completed in-scope issues as completed, then re-read the full milestone and require zero open issues. Leave the milestone state unchanged. Ordinary commits and standalone plans must work offline. Keep simulator cleanup and the user-owned plan close intact.
